title: Maintain the binding without recreating the work
when: When a checkout moves, a project setting changes, a refresh is needed or the project is retired.
need: Distinguish local operating-layer removal/refresh from project retirement, repository rebinding and universe deletion; preserve existing work identities and ownership.
surface: project install/refresh/snapshot; projects get/update/retire/unretire; checkout mapping
gap: Initial adoption and uninstall are covered elsewhere; ongoing project identity lifecycle is only catalogued here. Review question: should JOURNEYS include moved-checkout, retired-project and stale-layer situations?
